title: Speed at C
description: Essential: Correctly states that the speed at point C is determined by the condition for circular motion at the top: mg = m*v_C^2/R, yielding v_C = sqrt(gR).

title: Normal Force at B
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law for circular motion at point B: F_N - mg = m*v_B^2/R, using the given that the normal force on the track is 7mg.

title: Spring Potential Energy
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the initial elastic potential energy E_p as equal to the kinetic energy at B (1/2 * m * v_B^2) using conservation of mechanical energy from A to B.

title: Work Against Friction
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem from B to C, accounting for gravity and the work W done against resistance: -2mgR - W = (1/2)m(v_C^2 - v_B^2).

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Ensures all calculations use consistent units (m, kg, s, J) and correctly converts or handles values like g=10 m/s² and R=0.6 m.

title: Sign Error in Work
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly signs the work done by resistance (e.g., treating W as positive when it is energy dissipated, leading to a negative or incorrect magnitude).

title: Misinterpreting Normal Force
description: Pitfall: Confuses the normal force exerted by the track on the object with the force exerted by the object on the track, or misapplies the factor of 7.
